title: A second `#[Json\Field]` on one property is ignored and not reported.
text: The derive pass reads only the first `#[Json\Field]` on a property (`attribute_fields`, `crates/nvs-types/src/derive.rs:2478-2481`), so a second one is silently ignored. `rule:core-classes/derive-attribute` makes a field's overrides one attribute. Closing it means a diagnostic at the second attribute, the same code a repeated attribute gets elsewhere.
